JPM.rationale: JPM's fundamental trajectory is clearly constructive: Q1 2026 delivered record net income of $16.49B, EPS of $5.94 (+17.2% YoY), revenue of $49.84B (+10.0% YoY), and operating margin expanding to 41.1% from 37.5% a year prior. ROE improved to 16.2% from 15.5%, and the franchise remains best-in-class with 20%+ ROTCE, $4.48T AUM (+18% YoY), and diversified revenue streams across CCB, CIB, CB, and AWM. Valuation is mid-range at 15.0x P/E (vs. 17.8x peak in Jan 2026), meaning the market has compressed the multiple by ~16% even as fundamentals strengthened — a modestly asymmetric setup. The P/B of 2.43x is justified by the ROE premium vs. peers. On the risk side, the yield curve has flattened materially (10Y-2Y at 0.27%, -45% over 90 days), posing a direct threat to NII; nonaccrual loans surged 53% in Q1 signaling emerging credit stress; expenses are rising toward $106B; and the DOJ debanking probe adds legal uncertainty. operating cash remains O.
